name: ReportingAgent
description: Aggregates Playwright JSON results and test_suite.json into HTML and JSON execution reports. Always runs regardless of upstream step failures (always_run: true in full_workflow.yaml). Phase 1 (requirements.enabled): rebuilds traceability.json and adds a Requirements Traceability section — every AC with its tests and latest result, every AC with zero tests and the reason, and tests linked to no AC.

outputs.name: report_path
outputs.description: test_execution/reports/json/{ts}_{project}.json — includes report['traceability'] (summary, acs[], uncovered[] with reason, unlinked_tests[]; requirements.enabled only), report['quarantine'] and report['quality']

outputs.name: quality_gates
outputs.description: Phase 11 gate result {verdict, gates[]} when quality_gates / reporting.enhanced is set, else null
